_comment: LTX-2.5 image-to-video ComfyUI API-format workflow. Derived node-for-node from the OFFICIAL template at github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/video_ltx2_5_i2v.json (fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com). This is the API ('prompt') format ComfyUI's POST /prompt endpoint expects, converted from the UI graph-save format of the official template, which wraps almost the whole pipeline in a single UI 'subgraph' node (Image to Video (LTX-2.5)); that subgraph has been flattened here into its 47 constituent real nodes (ids taken from the official template) plus the outer LoadImage and SaveVideo nodes. The subgraph's own ResolutionSelector helper node (id 403 in the source) and the MarkdownNote documentation nodes were UI-only / superseded by direct numeric overrides and were dropped, since they have no class_type executable in API format and are not needed once WIDTH/HEIGHT are injected directly. {{IMAGE_FILENAME}} is substituted into node 395 (LoadImage, 'Load First Frame') - only include the surrounding LoadImage node when a start image is actually supplied. {{PROMPT}} is substituted into node 376 (PrimitiveStringMultiline 'Prompt'). {{SEED}} into node 339's noise_seed (the low-resolution-pass RandomNoise; the high-resolution pass, node 338, always uses the template's fixed seed 42, exactly as in the official template). {{WIDTH}} into node 372 (PrimitiveInt 'Width') and {{HEIGHT}} into node 360 (PrimitiveInt 'Height'). {{FPS}} into node 361 (PrimitiveInt 'Frame Rate'). {{FRAMES}} into node 362 (PrimitiveInt 'Duration') - NOTE: in the official template this parameter is actually 'duration in seconds', not a raw frame count; the template itself computes the real frame length internally as duration*frame_rate+1 via node 378 (ComfyMathExpression). {{FILENAME_PREFIX}} into node 75 (SaveVideo). The image-conditioning chain (nodes 351 ResizeImageMaskNode, 350 LTXVPreprocess, 357/349 LTXVImgToVideoInplace, 363 the 'Switch to Text to Video?' boolean) and the audio branch (nodes 358 LTXVAudioVAEDecode, 366 LTXVEmptyLatentAudio, 340/377 LTXVConcatAVLatent, 367/369 LTXVSeparateAVLatent) are kept exactly as in the official template with their real (non-placeholder) values, even though VOXini does not yet use the AUDIO output, per instructions not to remove nodes from the middle of the graph. Unlike the T2V template, this official template ships with prompt_enhance (node 383) defaulting to true (kept as-is, not a placeholder target); the prompt-enhancer text encoder for this workflow is gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors (a different, non-int8 variant than the one used by the T2V template) from the non-gated Comfy-Org/gemma-4 repo, loaded by node 393. This workflow requires models from the GATED Hugging Face repo https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5 (the user must request/accept access there first): ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors (diffusion_models), gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors (text_encoders), ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors and ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors (vae), and ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors (latent_upscale_models, used by the template's built-in 2x latent upscale pass). UNVERIFIED / FLAGGED for human review: (1) [RESOLVED after cross-check against docs.comfy.org/built-in-nodes/LTXVDualCFGGuider] LTXVDualCFGGuider (nodes 391, 388) - the two numeric widgets (both value 1 in the official template) are confirmed to be 'video_cfg' and 'audio_cfg' (FLOAT, default 3.0/7.0 respectively when not overridden by the template) and have been corrected accordingly - initially guessed as 'cfg1'/'cfg2', now fixed. (2) TextGenerateLTX2Prompt (node 380, exercised by default since prompt_enhance=true here) has ~11 additional numeric/boolean widgets in the official template (values: '',600,'on',0.7,64,0.95,0.05,1.15,0,0,false,true) whose exact input key names could not be determined from the UI JSON and were left unset here (ComfyUI will use the node's own server-side defaults); note this node also consumes the preprocessed first-frame image (node 350) as visual context for the enhancer. (3) LTXVImgToVideoInplace (nodes 357, 349) has an unnamed leading numeric widget (0.7 for the low-res pass, 1 for the high-res pass in the official template) alongside its named 'bypass' input; emitted here as 'strength' by best-effort naming. (4) LTXVPreprocess (node 350) has a single unnamed numeric widget (18 in the official template); emitted here as 'img_compression' by best-effort naming. (5) ResizeImageMaskNode (node 351) has three unnamed widgets ('scale longer dimension', 1536, 'lanczos' in the official template); emitted here as 'mode'/'value'/'interpolation' by best-effort naming. (6) ComfyMathExpression's formula-string widget is emitted as 'expression' by best-effort naming (its values.a/values.b/values.c input names are confirmed directly from the source JSON). (7) CreateVideo (node 370) has a second widgets_values entry (8) in the source with no corresponding named input in the UI JSON; it was left out. None of these seven items carry a {{...}} placeholder.
